Once #36793 merges, `form-view-internal-not-loaded` skips a default/create form whose served name exactly equals a `type: 'form'` action's literal target. These still say every non-public one is reported:

- [ ] `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:489` — "A non-public `form`, `formViews.default` or `formViews.create` still parses but changes nothing, and `os validate` reports it".
- [ ] `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx:13` — "an app that still declares one installs and runs, the form changes nothing, and `os validate` reports it".
- [ ] `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md:361` — "`os validate` warns `form-view-internal-not-loaded`". ⚠ `skills/**` is a governed surface: this item's PR goes through the governed handoff, not an area landing. Split it into its own PR from the two `content/docs` lines.
- [ ] Checklist `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` item `records-forms.form-view-gallery`: its default-form overlay recipe cannot stage a layout on `/new` or `/edit` since #36425. #36793 replaced only the stale mechanism text; the item needs a real re-audit of what it can still observe.
- [ ] Checklist `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` `view.form` row: same cause, same re-audit.

Ask: say what the rule now does (a form an action opens by name is not reported) in the three prose sites; re-audit the two checklist items (checklist-author).

## Business reason
An author reading the docs or the ui skill is told a form their action opens is dead and will be reported; they may delete a working form. The two checklist items describe a recipe that no longer stages anything.

Hands-on reader: the area seat repo:objectstack#7 puts it in (docs lines: any build area; skills line: governed handoff; checklist rows: checklist-author).
Dedupe: open+closed issues for `form-view-internal-not-loaded docs` (4: #36545, #36455 closed, #36425 closed, #6015 seat post), `PR #36793` (1: #36545).
